name: Skill Foundry Manage
description: Inspect, create, or patch self-generated procedural skills.

function.name: skill_foundry_manage
function.description: Manage procedural skills owned by Skill Foundry for this agent. Use list/view before creating a skill. Create or patch after a reusable non-trivial workflow, a recurring correction, or an explicit user request to retain a procedure. Prefer patching a matching skill. Tell the user briefly when a create or patch succeeds.

skill_id.description: Foundry skill ID for view or patch.

system_md.description: Complete standalone SYSTEM.md procedure for create.

old_text.description: Exact text that must occur once for patch.
